short_description: A salty-snacks CPG's deep BOGOs at its biggest retailer tripled volume but lost 63 cents per trade dollar. A UC-registered ML baseline model powers a post-event analysis that nets every promotion for pantry loading, cannibalization and forward buying; the Trade Promo Copilot app (Databricks App on Lakebase) forecasts next quarter's promo calendar, flags the money-losing events with evidence, checks the trade policy and the retailer's JBP through the Genie agent, which searches the policy documents, proposes a compliant re-plan and writes the approved plan back; finance tracks trade spend vs ROI in an AI/BI dashboard and Genie.
